content: For local-network multi-client apps needing bidirectional low-latency sync (clients both push and receive), WebSockets (<1ms LAN latency, full-duplex) are the better fit than SSE (unidirectional server->client, ~1-2ms latency, auto-reconnect). Since Barback writes inventory and all clients need near-instant updates, plus Bartender needs to receive new orders and patrons need live makeable-status, WebSockets (or Socket.IO for reconnection ergonomics) is recommended over SSE.
